systems.platform: Zzapp Malaria (software as a service, with a field workers' mobile app)
systems.tiers: Not facility-based: field workers mapping and treating water bodies; 2022 pilot in districts with urban and rural areas covering more than 160,000 people

note: An AI system for planning, assigning and monitoring anti-malaria field operations (larviciding, house spraying), one function only and not routine facility reporting or a patient record; no fact. The typology has no class for an operations tool, so single-function is the nearest fit and the parent may prefer to leave it unclassed. The body does not mention DHIS2 or an HMIS.
